+# Taskboard CLI
+
+Dependency-free task manager for Bun. Data is stored in `.taskboard.json` in the
+current directory, or at the path supplied in `TASKBOARD_FILE`.
+
+```sh
+bun run src/cli.ts add --title "Ship release" --tags Work,urgent --due 2026-09-10
+bun run src/cli.ts list --status open --tag work
+bun run src/cli.ts done 1
+bun run src/cli.ts stats
+bun run src/cli.ts delete 1
+```
+
+Every successful command emits one JSON value to stdout. Invalid commands,
+arguments, dates, missing tasks, and malformed databases fail without replacing
+
+Run the self-tests with:
+
+```sh
+bun test
+```

60:   const temporary = `${databaseFile}.tmp-${process.pid}-${Date.now()}`;
61:   try {
62:     await Bun.write(temporary, `${JSON.stringify(db, null, 2)}\n`);
63:     await Bun.write(temporary, Bun.file(temporary));
64:     await Bun.file(temporary).exists();
65:     await Bun.spawn(["mv", temporary, databaseFile]).exited;
66:   } catch {
